static_traits.name: Lin Hao
static_traits.social_status: Has several close friends to confide in, but not yet discussed these feelings with them
static_traits.medical_history: not yet experienced similar psychological problems;not yet received psychotherapy;without significant physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Strong self-criticism, using derogatory self-labels; prone to black-and-white and catastrophic expressions; able to describe experiences and thoughts clearly; avoiding sharing with others out of shame

basic_info.main_problem: Recently broke the healthy routine by eating some chips in the morning, triggering intense feelings of failure and self-criticism; thereafter, whenever a minor slip occurs in the healthy routine, the feeling of failure intensifies and appears frequently.
basic_info.core_demands: Intense self-criticism and sense of failure have begun affecting daily life and mental health; hoping to break this negative cycle, feel more at peace, enjoy life better, and no longer stay tense and anxious over mistakes.

special_situations.event: Ate chips in the morning, breaking the healthy-awareness streak
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I eat unhealthy food once, it equals total failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Constantly restating health goals and immediately placing strict Demands on oneself

special_situations.event: Small slip in health routine (not yet able to follow health habits perfectly)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If my execution is not perfect, it means I am no good
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Forcing oneself to execute perfectly through harsh self-criticism
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I cannot do anything well,I cannot stick to anything

special_situations.event: Any slight deviation from the set health plan
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: One mistake will erase all past efforts and progress
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids discussing with friends to avoid embarrassment and being evaluated

special_situations.event: When reviewing recent health performance, only focusing on the mistakes I made
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Negative performance matters more; the positive part 'does not count'
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Uses self-reproach to stay vigilant, ignoring positive evidence
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I messed up again; it shows I am simply no good

core_conflict.wish: Longs to maintain self-discipline and health and be seen as someone who 'can do it'
core_conflict.fear: Fears that any slip means she is a failure, all previous efforts wasted
defense_goal: Avoids slips by setting perfect standards and harsh self-criticism
Avoids sharing with others to reduce embarrassment and the risk of being evaluated

object_relations.self_representation: Not disciplined enough, a person prone to failure
object_relations.object_representation: Others may judge or look down on my group

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When talking about any small slip in health habits, or when asked whether these feelings are shared with friends
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Interpreting others' attention or Questioning as judgment and negation of one's failure
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Describing oneself in a self-blaming tone, using derogatory labels like 'failure'; downplaying or denying positive progress; avoiding in-depth communication with others.

manifestations: Constraining one's choices with the standard of perfection and 'no deviation allowed'
Equating one slip with total failure, finding it hard to allow human imperfection
outcomes: Decreased motivation and Lowered sense of self-worth
Hard to enjoy life and maintain self-care

contact_model.definition: The individual has impaired self-Reflection and introspection, with excessive self-limitation and self-reproach, being overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: Unwilling to share troubles with friends before counseling, fearing embarrassment and being judged

contact_model.definition: The individual turns the energy originally intended to be expressed or sought outward toward himself, directing impulses or needs toward the self.
manifestations: Not seeking support from friends, turning instead to self-criticism and self-punishment
Turning disappointment and pressure back into self-blame

positive_force: Strong health awareness with clear health goals
Willing to seek counseling and try to change
Has several close friends, with potential support resources
Can clearly describe and be aware of one's own negative thinking and its impact
negative_force: Cognitive biases such as catastrophizing, all-or-nothing thinking, overgeneralization, and mental filtering are prominent
Frequent and harsh self-labeling and self-criticism
Negating positive progress, focusing on mistakes
Perfectionism and extremely high standards lead to Increased stress and Decreased motivation
Avoiding seeking social support out of shame

target_behavior.behavior: After tiny deviations in health habits, engages in harsh self-criticism and failure-based self-labeling
antecedent: Behaviors deviating from the healthy plan, such as eating chips in the morning
Small mistakes in the health routine
Not yet able to perfectly follow established health habits
target_behavior.core_reason: Perfectionism and Black-and-white cognitive tendencies, equating one slip with total failure, and catastrophically predicting 'never being healthy'.
target_behavior.function: Trying to reinforce self-discipline through self-punishment and negative self-talk, avoiding further slips and maintaining a sense of control over behavior
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased motivation,Anxiety and Increasing stress, daily self-care and life rhythm affected
